audit.summary: The optimal linear-adapter theorem returns a singular inadmissible matrix for D>1; existence and convexity claims also fail. A tabulated MAE violates its paired MSE bound. Current released predictive summaries and outer-fold head training have local implementation defects; historical empirical consequences unresolved.

proposition.claim:
Proposition 3.3 / Appendix A.1 returns an invertible global optimum using (B^T A)^+ B^T B under a shared-bias affine FM.

Tables1/6 give corresponding test MSE and MAE averaged across3runs.

ADAPTS.predict_multi_step returns predictive mean and lower/upper summaries after decoding.

Hyperparameter optimization uses outer-fold validation of the fitted forecasting pipeline.

repair.content:
For b!=0 optimize q^T=1^T W^-1 over nonzero rows; q*^T=b^T A/(b^T b). If q*!=0, choose an invertible completion; if q*=0 no minimum is attained. If b=0 all invertible W have equal loss.

Recompute MAE from bound run predictions and correct percentage to approximately3.89% for displayed numbers.

Decode joint draws first with consistent model/normalization state, then compute output-space mean, standard deviation or quantiles.

Reinitialize trainable head and adapter each outer fold; restrict supervised fitting and inner validation to outer-training data.
